connector.name: Scholar MCP Server
connector.registryDescription: Scholarly-sources MCP: papers, patents, books, standards - search and cross-reference prior art.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package pvliesdonk-scholar-mcp. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the pvliesdonk account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

env.description: Persistent-state backend URL for pvl-core subsystems. Schemes: file:///path (survives restarts), memory:// (dev/ephemeral).

env.name: SCHOLAR_MCP_OIDC_JWT_SIGNING_KEY
env.description: JWT signing key — required on Linux/Docker to survive restarts (generate with: openssl rand -hex 32)
